description: With \(I=(p\lor q)\to r\), \(H=I\land\neg s\), and \(\Gamma=\{p,H\}\), the specified factor tree of \(\Gamma\Rightarrow r\) applies conjunction-left to \(H\), then implication-left to \(I\). Its antecedent tree left-introduces \(p\lor q\) from atomic \(p\), and its continuation is atomic \(r\).
